name: cache-timer
description: Shows how long the prompt cache stays warm, as a dim Cache mm:ss countdown in the footer of Claude Code Desktop, restarted by each model response of the main thread. The cache lifetime (5 minutes or 1 hour, per account) is learned from the responses: a cache read after more than five idle minutes means one hour, a full rewrite means five; until then the countdown shows ~ and assumes five

ttlMinutes.title: Cache lifetime in minutes
ttlMinutes.description: Fix the cache lifetime instead of learning it: 60 for the 1-hour cache, 5 for the 5-minute one, 0 to learn it from the responses.

warnMinutes.title: Warn this many minutes before it expires
warnMinutes.description: The countdown turns orange in its last minutes.
